title: Erdős Problem #1155: Triangle Removal Process
description: Is it true that E[f(n)] ≍ n^{3/2} and f(n) ≪ n^{3/2} almost surely?

overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1155 concerns triangle removal process. This problem remains OPEN.

Known results include: - Grable (1997): For every ε > 0, P(f(n) > n^{7/4 + ε}) → 0. - Bohman, Frieze, Lubetzky (2015): f(n) = n^{3/2 + o(1)} almost surely.

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1155.
